title: Poker Home Game Buy-In vs Net Result
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokerhome:session
| search net_result=*
| stats avg(buyin_amount) as avg_buyin_amount sum(net_result) as net_result by player_name
| sort 0 - avg_buyin_amount
description: Ranks playerss by home-game net results.
value: Buy-in and net-result splits show whether one format or one player pool is changing the economics of the night.
implementation: Send home-game net results events to `index=personal` and keep `player_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of home-game net results by players.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which playerss stand out most for home-game net results.
